description: Secured ingress route configuration generation. For the local service the factory builds an ingress route configuration from these inputs: whether the status route and its virtual cluster are enabled, whether public admin access is enabled together with an admin token and a list of secured admin sub-paths (path prefix plus HTTP method), the per-incoming timeout policy, the health-check definition, a default retry policy, and a map of per-HTTP-method retry policies. The single virtual host matches all domains and, when status virtual clusters are enabled, exposes 'status' and 'endpoints' virtual clusters. The default retry policy (when enabled) is attached to the virtual host with its retry-on conditions joined by commas and its retry count. Generated routes appear in this order: secured admin sub-path routes (an authorized variant gated on the token plus an unauthorized fallback returning 401), then the public admin POST authorized/unauthorized routes, the public admin catch-all route, and the public admin redirect route, followed by one local-service route per enabled per-method retry policy (each matching that method and carrying a retry policy) and finally a catch-all local-service route without a retry policy. Output reports the route-config name, virtual-host name, sorted domains, virtual cluster names, the virtual-host retry-on string and retry count, the total route count, and per route the path prefix, matched method(s), the action (cluster target, direct-response status, or redirect) and whether it carries a retry policy.
